known_scope_limits: No real-data execution or scientific performance claims
Independent coordinate links are candidate hypotheses
SC donor SD is descriptive spread, not a confidence interval
Patient HC3 inference is descriptive association; current-core candidate selection is exploratory
Current core CLI verification substitutes a deterministic tiny graph/model; no real checkpoint inference was run
Drug attribution uses actual frozen forward passes but explains association strength, not sensitivity direction or pharmacological causality.
ENCODE functional bridges remain RBP depletion evidence; no lncRNA perturbation or external-validation claim.
RBNS sequence scores are predictions; the separate typed relation artifact has not entered a real graph/training run.
C11 current-C three-arm preparation, actual training loader and frozen export are code-implemented and fixture-verified; no real expansion/training/effect comparison was run.
The synthetic comparison uses fixture authority metadata and tiny tensors; it does not attest real patient data, graph quality or scientific accuracy.
C12 audit independently recomputes aggregation with SQL but shares raw-source normalization adapters; it is not biological external validation.

C12 tests exercise actual native producers, audit/query, fusion preparation and public serializers with synthetic files and fixed coefficients only; no optimizer or scientific production analysis was run.
Historical native event artifacts cannot recover discarded context/review fields; obtaining those fields requires rematerializing the upstream events from raw sources.
External isolation is explicitly REGISTERED_MODEL_USE_ONLY; no complete biological-independence attestation or real external performance is claimed.

External source replay uses the same metric implementation; separate analytic tests verify weighted AUROC/AP, tie handling and paired differences. Intervals are exploratory and not multiplicity adjusted.
C14 selected exact/fusion score snapshots, Gene Sets, subtype weighting, coverage, GMT, queries and external consumption are fixture-verified; no real candidate release has been produced.
The selected-analysis 46-case suite verifies this change plus legacy subtype/GeneSet, external and current fusion/rule consumer regressions; cumulative counts are not a full-suite rerun.
Existing G012 validation locks may be consumed; explicit source registration claims no validated winner. Diagnostic fusion status remains unchanged.
Fold stability for final fusion scores is unavailable rather than fabricated. Unknown primary direction cannot enter directional subtypes.
C15 has a bound query/download backend but no completed website/API/frontend integration. No deployment was performed.
Native current V4 full-candidate five-fold inference and source-bound selected analysis consumption are fixture-verified; no actual scientific checkpoint or cohort was inferred.
The current prediction 46-case suite covers native inference, selected analysis and external consumers. Cumulative counts are not one full current-suite run.

Default current prediction verification rechecks source hashes and recomputes the fold ensemble; optional frozen-checkpoint replay reruns all five models. Neither establishes biological external validity.
C01/C05/C08/C13/C15/C16 remain unfinished. C05 still requires native Mutation/CNV/ATAC adapters, State/Clinical context and authentic post-selection fusion-label authority.
No bound current Ridge producer exists. Full-candidate predictions supply primary and L1 scores and are not held-out or independent external evaluation.
